Jack Reacher -LRB- formerly called One Shot , or alternatively known as Jack Reacher : One Shot -RRB- is a 2012 American action thriller film written and directed by Christopher McQuarrie , based on Lee Child 's 2005 novel One Shot .	Christopher McQuarrie	Christopher McQuarrie	One Shot	One Shot (novel)	Lee Child	Lee Child	action	action film	thriller film	thriller film

The film stars Tom Cruise as the title character , with Rosamund Pike , David Oyelowo , Richard Jenkins , Jai Courtney , Werner Herzog and Robert Duvall also starring .	Tom Cruise	Tom Cruise	Rosamund Pike	Rosamund Pike	Richard Jenkins	Richard Jenkins	Werner Herzog	Werner Herzog	David Oyelowo	David Oyelowo	Robert Duvall	Robert Duvall	the title character	Jack Reacher	Jai Courtney	Jai Courtney
The film entered production in October 2011 , and concluded in January 2012 .
It was filmed entirely on location in Pittsburgh , Pennsylvania .	Pittsburgh	Pittsburgh	Pennsylvania	Pennsylvania
It received generally positive reviews and performed well at the box office .
The film was released in North America on December 21 .

The musical score was composed by Joe Kraemer , performed by the Hollywood Studio Symphony and recorded at the Sony Scoring Stage in Culver City , California .	Joe Kraemer	Joe Kraemer (composer)	Hollywood Studio Symphony	Hollywood Studio Symphony
Cruise performed all of his own driving stunts during the film 's signature car chase sequence .
Cruise reprised his role in the sequel , Jack Reacher : Never Go Back , based on the 2013 novel Never Go Back , which was released in October 2016 .	Never Go Back	Never Go Back (Lee Child novel)
